# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through GitHub: [open a private vulnerability report](https://github.com/wp-document-revisions/wp-document-revisions/security/advisories/new). Don't open a public issue, pull request, or support forum thread for a security problem.

A good report includes the plugin version, the WordPress version, the user role needed to trigger the issue, and steps to reproduce it.

## What happens next

The maintainers work on the report privately with you in the advisory. Once a fix ships, we publish the advisory, credit you unless you'd rather not be named, and note the fix in the [changelog](https://github.com/wp-document-revisions/wp-document-revisions/blob/main/docs/changelog.md).

## Supported versions

Security fixes ship in the latest release, so keep the plugin up to date.
